scope: Audited data defects, with current engine adaptations and regression tests.

findings.title: Door closing can bypass protection-zone and house-entry restrictions
findings.resolution: Expose Tile:queryAdd and validate every pushed creature before teleporting. Native checks enforce house invitations and PZ/PvP restrictions. Upstream uses typed canEnter methods and current zone APIs.

findings.title: Already harvested roots produce unlimited rewards
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Escape confirms paid imbuement operations instead of cancelling
findings.resolution: Default Enter/Escape now use the actual button IDs.

findings.title: Imbuement choices are shared across players and bypass item restrictions
findings.resolution: Upstream removed the old imbuement shrine and legacy Imbuement Lua APIs. src/item.cpp discards legacy ATTR_IMBUESLOTS/ATTR_IMBUEMENTS during deserialization. No obsolete shrine, helper APIs or chance code was reintroduced.

findings.title: Abandoned modal windows retain disconnected players and inventories
findings.resolution: Consume callbacks before invoking them; clean failed sends, logout, offline players, expiry and reload. Native pending IDs are invalidated through Player:forgetModalWindow.

findings.title: House wrapping permission accepts part of another player's name
findings.resolution: Use house:canEditAccessList(GUEST_LIST, player), the engine's parsed authorization.

findings.title: Old imbuement confirmations can modify an item after ownership changes
findings.resolution: Upstream removed the old imbuement shrine and legacy Imbuement Lua APIs. src/item.cpp discards legacy ATTR_IMBUESLOTS/ATTR_IMBUEMENTS during deserialization. No obsolete shrine, helper APIs or chance code was reintroduced.

findings.title: Monster storage records survive non-death removal
findings.resolution: Avoid allocations on reads, delete cleared records, clean death immediately and sweep non-death removals every 60 seconds. Only numeric Lua records are retained, never creatures.

findings.title: Door movement callbacks call player/monster-only storage APIs on NPCs
findings.resolution: Store door entry positions in transient per-creature ID state that works for NPCs, with a sweep for removed creatures.

findings.title: Four registered locked door IDs can never unlock
findings.resolution: Use explicit reversible keyed-door pairs. Door 14634 correctly maps to 14633; 13236,13237,14641 are excluded from keyed registration because no matching open asset exists.

findings.title: Five map teleports point to missing tiles
findings.resolution: Remove exactly five broken teleport nodes, 55 bytes total, without rewriting other map data. No destinations were invented.

findings.title: All three shipped raids spawn outside the supplied map
findings.resolution: Rename off-map example_raids.toml to example_raids.toml.example. The example remains available but cannot announce raids at nonexistent tiles.

findings.title: Roping another player bypasses protection-zone lock
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Rope destination occupancy check is always false
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Fresh characters skip the gravedigger taming sequence
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Potion restrictions validate the user instead of the recipient
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Demonic blood fails when held directly in an equipment slot
findings.resolution: If no output slot is available, the input is kept and a not-enough-room error is returned.

findings.title: Rust remover crashes on six configured rusty item types
findings.resolution: Empty loot configurations follow the existing configured break/failure behavior. No new reward odds were invented.

findings.title: Every marble-sculpting attempt destroys the marble
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Werewolf helmet enchanting always reaches missing configuration
findings.resolution: All former skill branches pointed at result 24783, so the unused missing storage selection was replaced with that explicit existing result.

findings.title: Plague bell uses an undefined storage key
findings.resolution: Existing storage 0 was not migrated because it can contain unrelated state. No database migration or live player modification was performed.

findings.title: Beak Doctor achievement checks an undefined outfit ID
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Death-list command cannot accept a player name
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Public sendtext command sends a malformed text packet
findings.resolution: The debug display now uses native sendTextMessage serialization and requires staff access.

findings.title: Buying premium exceeds the configured 365-day cap
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Registered post horn has no instrument configuration
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Glooth food rewards have no usable food action
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Empty crate rolls bypass the search cooldown
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Summon Creature calls a nonexistent ManaCost method
findings.resolution: Use the registered manaCost getter.

findings.title: Animate Dead bypasses the two-summon limit
findings.resolution: Reject capped casts before creating a monster or consuming a corpse, preserving the CanSummonAll bypass used by Summon Creature.

findings.title: Eleven item definitions refer to missing augment names
findings.resolution: Align nine augment definition names and the earmuffs reference with the intended item names, restoring all eleven affected item references.

findings.title: Ornate legs resist every damage type because of a misspelled damage filter
findings.resolution: Change fiphysicalre to physical.

findings.title: Conjure Wand of Darkness references an unavailable item
findings.resolution: Preserve the script under the loader's # disabled-file convention, with a comment identifying missing item 28416 and its client assets.

findings.title: Three monster summon definitions reference nonexistent monster names
findings.resolution: Ported the two name corrections and unavailable-minion disable to current Lua monster definitions, preserving all other upstream behavior.

findings.title: Migration advances the database version even when its SQL fails
findings.resolution: Check CREATE TABLE and all ALTER TABLE results, return false immediately on failure, and retain idempotent behavior for partial upgrades.

findings.title: Failed imbuement application still charges and reports success
findings.resolution: Upstream removed the old imbuement shrine and legacy Imbuement Lua APIs. src/item.cpp discards legacy ATTR_IMBUESLOTS/ATTR_IMBUEMENTS during deserialization. No obsolete shrine, helper APIs or chance code was reintroduced.

findings.title: Expired imbuements leave Lua-added critical and leech chance behind
findings.resolution: Upstream removed the old imbuement shrine and legacy Imbuement Lua APIs. src/item.cpp discards legacy ATTR_IMBUESLOTS/ATTR_IMBUEMENTS during deserialization. No obsolete shrine, helper APIs or chance code was reintroduced.

findings.title: Staged bank transfers reject every recipient before looking them up
findings.resolution: Resolve recipient before checking lookup result.

findings.title: Unknown recipients raise a Lua error in one-line bank transfers
findings.resolution: Validate lookup before accessing name or vocation; compare vocation IDs.

findings.title: Bank amount parsing errors on ordinary nonnumeric replies
findings.resolution: Check digit match before substring, reject overflow and nonfinite/noninteger values.

findings.title: Scheduled server save performs no save when close and shutdown are disabled
findings.resolution: Call saveServer when neither close nor shutdown supplies the save.

findings.title: Trekolt's random ship destination is chosen once at script load
findings.resolution: Allow a destination function, evaluated for each confirmed voyage.

findings.title: Door item pushing reports success after a failed move
findings.resolution: Honor item:moveTo and creature:teleportTo failures and keep searching candidate positions.

findings.title: Malformed looktype parameter raises a Lua error
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Multispawn and multisummon accept invalid range indexes
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Death-list dates use incorrect ordinal suffixes after day nine
findings.resolution: Corrected behavior with regression coverage in tests/data.

findings.title: Monster spell helper functions overwrite one another in the shared Lua state
findings.resolution: No upstream edit: all six scripts already use direct per-spell Combat:getPositions loops with local per-cast state, and define no shared spellCallback.

findings.title: Quoted chance values make Warden's Calling effects trigger every time
findings.resolution: Use integer probabilities for all five modifiers.

findings.title: Varak travel charges more than the quoted fare
findings.resolution: Charge quoted 150 gold.

additional_safeguards.title: Oversized coin conversion can overflow native count
additional_safeguards.resolution: Bound exchange outputs to 10000 coins (100 stacks), constrain multiplication before native calls.

additional_safeguards.title: Delayed speech dereferences missing entities
additional_safeguards.resolution: Resolve and validate both player and NPC before scheduling/speaking.

additional_safeguards.title: Pressure plate dereferences missing neighboring tile
additional_safeguards.resolution: Guard Tile lookup before depot query.

additional_safeguards.title: Multiple auction wins reuse stale balance
additional_safeguards.resolution: Atomic conditional UPDATE JOIN charges current balance and assigns house owner together, then mirrors resulting owner into memory.

additional_corrections: Door fallback rounds respect configured occupant restrictions.
Native modal IDs are released on cancellation, replacement, expiry and reload.
Restore the Phantasm Summon registry key lost during upstream Lua migration.
deployment: Rebuild the server to include Tile:queryAdd and Player:forgetModalWindow before deploying the data files.
Some unavailable content is explicitly disabled or removed, as detailed in tests/data/README.txt.
This change does not repair already affected player inventories, balances or storage values in a live database.
